title: Ultimate UI source entry
description: One indexed upstream project. One file per source under catalog/sources/. Never vendor upstream content here - link to it and describe how an agent should consume it.

id.description: Stable slug. Must match the filename. Never change it once merged - skills reference it.

name.description: Human display name, spelled the way the authors spell it.

homepage.description: Docs site or product page, if any.

author.description: Who gets credit. Required. See docs/attribution-policy.md.

name.description: Owning person or organization as they present themselves.

credit_note.description: Optional extra credit, e.g. original creator when the repo moved to an org.

license.description: SPDX identifier of the upstream license, or NOASSERTION if unclear.

summary.description: What it is, in the maintainers' own framing where possible.

kind.description: Primary shape of the project. Drives how skills consume it.

stacks.description: Controlled vocabulary from catalog/taxonomy.json -> stacks. Empty means stack-agnostic.

style_tags.description: Controlled vocabulary from catalog/taxonomy.json -> style_tags. Used by the style-scout skill to match an aesthetic brief to a source.

agent_entrypoints.description: How an agent actually pulls real data from this source. This is what makes the catalog actionable instead of a link list. Verify every URL before merging.

type.description: llms_txt: agent-oriented docs digest. registry_json: machine-readable component index. raw_path: raw.githubusercontent.com path or pattern. cli: a command. mcp: an MCP server. api: other HTTP API.

url.description: URL, path pattern, or command. Patterns may use {placeholders}.

what.description: What an agent gets back and when to reach for it.

verified.description: Date this entrypoint was last confirmed reachable.

use_when.description: Concrete situations where this is the right source to reach for.

avoid_when.description: Honest limits. A catalog with no avoid_when entries is a marketing page, not an index.

provides.description: Named units this source exposes - skills, brand profiles, component sets.

metrics.description: Point-in-time popularity signal. Never a ranking - it goes stale and it is not a quality measure.

upstream.description: GENERATED by scripts/refresh.mjs. Point-in-time upstream health, recorded so anyone reading the catalog can see how fresh an entry is. Never hand-edit.

last_commit.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent push to the default branch.

latest_release.description: Tag of the latest non-prerelease GitHub release, or null if the project publishes none.

checked.description: When refresh.mjs last confirmed these values.

watch.description: Hand-written, optional. Where new content appears upstream, so the weekly refresh can flag a review when it does - e.g. a new skill folder or a new section in a curated list. Only watch things the entry actually describes (usually `provides`).

paths.description: Repository path patterns. `*` matches within one path segment and its match is the item name: `skills/*` yields one item per skill folder.

headings.description: Markdown headings to watch in a repository file, e.g. the sections of a curated list.

review.description: When a person last re-read the upstream project and confirmed the judgement fields. Written by scripts/review.mjs, never by hand. The weekly refresh flags the entry when upstream drifts from `baseline` or the review is over 6 months old.

baseline.description: Upstream snapshot at review time: description, homepage, release_major, watched. Generated.

notes.description: Anything a maintainer should know: licensing quirks, upstream churn, category mismatch.
